name: Hush Companion
tagline: A calm, voice-first space for thinking out loud
description: Talk it out, think it through, or simply listen. Hush Companion gives you four conversation modes powered by AI: Vent (speak freely, get calm reflections), Debate (steelman both sides of any argument), Listen (get clear explanations on any topic), and Wellness (grounding, breathing, and workday reset exercises). Voice-first, privacy-conscious, and open source. Uses Anna's built-in AI or your own Google Gemini key. No subscription. No lock-in.
